newsitem.title: MEXICO: Emvasa sets price for share subscription.
newsitem.headline: Emvasa sets price for share subscription.

text.p: Mexican soft-drinks bottler Embotelladores del Valle de Anahuac SA de CV (Emvasa) said on Thursday it had fixed a subscription price of 4.60 pesos per share for its forthcoming stock issue.

Emvasa said in a report to the Mexican stock exchange it intended to raise capital by issuing 16,422,264 shares, to be subscribed at a ratio of one new B class share to 6.7942968155 former A or B class shares.

"This is the official subscription factor calculated by the Securities Depository Institute (Indeval). The previous (factor) was a company calculation, and we overshot," an Emvasa official told Reuters.
The Rello family already has exercised preferential stockholders' rights and subscribed to 13,466,256 shares at a fixed price of 4.60 pesos per share.
A total of 2,596,008 shares are thus now available for subscription by remaining shareholders.
The subscription period began March 12 and will run until March 27.
